content.text:
In the vitest 5.0.3 installed here, `--reporter=blob` writes to **`.vitest/blob/blob.json`** under the project root, unless you set `outputFile`. If you shard the run, the file name gets the shard added, for example `.vitest/blob/blob-1-3.json`. If you set a merge-reports label, that goes in the name too.

This is a change from older versions, which wrote to `.vitest-reports/blob.json`. `--merge-reports` now reads from the same `.vitest/blob` folder by default. If your CI scripts upload or collect `.vitest-reports/`, update those paths.

I confirmed this in the installed package's code (`node_modules/vitest/dist/chunks/index.DpLw24bj.js:15805` and `:15940`), not just in the project's lessons file.
